patterns.key_values: save-card mosaic; two archetypes: text-forward (coloured type-badge -> bold title -> 2-4 line secondary body) and media (full-bleed photo thumb + overlay caption + platform provenance badge + status line 'Saved / N saves / transcript ready'); ~14-16px radius; #111 fill on #050 backdrop; free-scatter marketing layout, not a verified product grid
thread-notification save card (circular avatar, name, @handle, X-dismiss, body, 'Show this thread - 1/7' muted-blue link) = ingested X/Twitter save; borrows social-feed schema wholesale (Jakob's Law)

signature_moves: Stage-and-paint inversion: UI is a pure #050505 void, the user's own photographic saves supply 100% of the colour (café / strawberries / coffee / cliffs / desk gear as a curated gallery) — the whole 'second brain for creators' identity in one decision

Role-coded content-type tags (HOOK amber / SCRIPT blue / IDEA green) — a save is a typed creative artifact, chunked into 3-5 recall-friendly categories, muted mid-saturation hues on dark translucent pills

Brand tension: photoreal chrome / Y2K emblem (retro-futurist luxe) against a restrained dark-mode content tool — coherent across icon+cover but off-platform, reads 'premium marque' more than 'creator tool'
defects: Contrast Dilution (mild, intentional) — text cards #111111 vs #050505 backdrop give <3:1 container UI-contrast; cards read via content + faint edge only
Evidentiary: no window chrome anywhere -> lineage unverifiable -> zero contribution to macOS canon; marketing covers systematically over-polish vs the real app
Off-platform accent — bespoke muted link/tag palette instead of system accent (unverified whether it carries into the shipped app)

aesthetic.direction: Dark content-mosaic / gallery-consumer — a near-black neutral stage where photographic content is the color; remix of Neo-grotesque-product (dark neutral) surface with a Pinterest/lookbook mosaic, softened toward consumer by a friendly rounded display face; a Retro-futurist/Y2K flourish confined to the chrome emblem

psychology: Von Restorff / signal-detection — single white headline on a black stage is the one high-contrast focal; unmissable first-impression thesis
Aesthetic-Usability Effect (Kurosu & Kashimura) — the cinematic gallery buys first-contact trust; halo, not proof of usability
Jakob's Law / schemas — save-card + platform-provenance-badge + thread-notification borrow the trained social-feed model so creators parse the app instantly
Miller/Cowan chunking — role-coded HOOK/SCRIPT/IDEA tags keep the content taxonomy inside the 3-5 working-memory band
Picture superiority + peripheral vision — photographic thumbnails in the periphery pull the eye, apt for a visual tool (and exploited by the marketing)
notes: CRITICAL for synthesis: this is a macapp.supply MARKETING COVER COMPOSITE (1200x630 web render), not an app-window screenshot. There is NO native chrome (no traffic lights, toolbar, sidebar, controls, forms). Therefore: lineage=unknown/low, era=unknown, native_audit_score=0 means 'unassessable' NOT 'scored zero', and NOTHING here may feed macOS canon or a native style cluster. All tokens (estimated) from a single non-native surface — none promotable. What the render DOES evidence: the brand aesthetic (dark cinematic gallery, rounded-sans display, chrome Y2K emblem) and the information model (typed social-content saves as cards, role-coded tags, provenance badges). Weak non-native tells present (tracked-uppercase tags, card-scatter, X-dismiss, custom link-blue) lean consumer/web but are unverified marketing renders — record as tells-with-caveat only. Brand coherence with icons/creos.md is strong (same chrome glyph + white rounded-sans CREOS wordmark on near-black). Highest-value next input: one real app-window screenshot — it would establish lineage and unlock everything this cover cannot.
